requirements.quote: b. Each header line must be followed by **at least one** line of corresponding data.

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys
L = open('/home/user/diagnostics/sys_snapshot.log').read().split('\n')
H = ['=== DATE & TIME ===', '=== DISK USAGE (/home/user) ===', '=== MEMORY STATUS (MiB) ===', '=== TOP 5 MEMORY PROCESSES ===']
ok = all(h in L and L.index(h) + 1 < len(L) and L[L.index(h) + 1].strip() != '' and L[L.index(h) + 1] not in H for h in H)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF

requirements.quote: c. After the final data line of the “TOP 5 MEMORY PROCESSES” section there must be **no trailing blank line**.

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys
s = open('/home/user/diagnostics/sys_snapshot.log').read()
sys.exit(0 if s.strip() and not s.endswith('\n\n') and s.rstrip('\n').split('\n')[-1].strip() != '' else 1)
PYEOF

requirements.quote: <The current date and time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS>

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, sys
L = open('/home/user/diagnostics/sys_snapshot.log').read().split('\n')
i = L.index('=== DATE & TIME ===')
sys.exit(0 if re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}', L[i + 1].strip()) else 1)
PYEOF
